result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a high-visibility marked crosswalk at a signalized intersection. While sidewalks and basic crossing markings are present, the long unprotected crossing distance and lack of pedestrian refuge islands or curb extensions increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four travel lanes plus parking lanes without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks and overhead traffic signals, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway width and presence of parked vehicles near the corners create visibility challenges and increase the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians are exposed to traffic for a significant distance across multiple lanes without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time remaining.
